# ARGs with `form` `source`

*Argument forms — The form of inference an ARG makes, and with it the critical questions that inference has to survive (Walton's argumentation schemes). An ARG answers each question in its body or is objected to (ADR-032).*

**Source** — a reading of a work grounds a claim. Critical questions: does the work say this, read in context? Is it said within the scope the claim needs? Does the claim lean on the reading for more than the reading holds? (ADR-061).
